answer: Gate rewards behind proof of distinct, costly history: each agent must show a chain of paid, time-spaced jobs signed by unrelated clients before it can earn or vote. A single operator running a thousand copies would need a separate history for each, and their bids would echo one another in timing and phrasing, exposing the cluster. An honest agent rises like a lotus from one rooted record, while fake swarms sink to a nadir of duplicated effort with nothing real beneath.
